candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije – GIZ (Bank Association of Slovenia) — main site
candidates.why_relevant: Central industry body of the Slovenian banking sector (banks, savings banks, leasing companies). Its site is the top-level hub for member directories, sector data pages, guidelines/standards, press positions and the Bančni vestnik journal — the single richest pointer node for the association layer in SI.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the section index pages (clanice, publikacije, podatki-bancnega-sektorja, sporocila-za-javnost-in-novice, smernice, standardi-in-prirocniki); diff-based change detection; PDF harvest.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl seed query + site navigation extraction
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije bilten plačilni promet člani
Bank Association of Slovenia members payment systems report

candidates.source_name: ZBS — Članice (member directory: banks, savings banks, leasing companies)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative actor map: lists member banks/savings banks (NLB, SKB, OTP, Intesa Sanpaolo, UniCredit, Addiko, Sparkasse, BKS, Delavska hranilnica, Direktna banka, SID, GB, Ljubljanska banka, Probanka) and a separate leasing-company tier (BKS Leasing, DH Leasing, Mobilize Financial Services, Toyota/Volvo/Scania Finance, SKB Leasing, Sparkasse Leasing, NLB Lease&Go). The leasing tier reveals consumer-finance actors that a pure bank register does not label.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML scrape of member cards → entity list with names/links; snapshot quarterly to detect entries/exits (M&A signal).
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije bilten plačilni promet člani

candidates.source_name: ZBS — Podatki bančnega sektorja (banking sector indicators)
candidates.why_relevant: Association-curated sector indicators (number of banks, employees, balance-sheet total, ROA/ROE, corporate and household loans/deposits). Sourced from Banka Slovenije but pre-aggregated into a stable time-series presentation — a convenient market-structure baseline. Note: observed as chart images, not machine-readable payment/card/ATM data.
candidates.legal_status: public; underlying data credited to Banka Slovenije
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape chart image assets + captions; prefer Banka Slovenije originals for numeric series. Low-frequency (annual) refresh.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije bilten plačilni promet člani

candidates.source_name: ZBS — Sporočila za javnost in novice (press releases / position statements)
candidates.why_relevant: Where the sector's collective lobbying position is stated: observed items on cash accessibility ('Bančni sektor podpira dostopnost gotovine, želi pa, da bo rešitev dolgoročno vzdržna in pravična'), digital euro pilot participation, instant payments, contactless limits and card-fraud alerts. Directly quantifies/locates sector pain points on cash access and ATM network economics.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl year filters 2021–present and category pages; keyword filter on gotovina/bankomat/kartic/provizij/takojšnja plačila/digitalni evro; store full text + date. No RSS feed observed — poll weekly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: navigation + page fetch of news index
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije bilten plačilni promet člani

candidates.source_name: ZBS — Letna poročila (annual reports, 2001–2025, SL+EN)
candidates.why_relevant: 25-year run of association annual reports describing working committees (incl. payments), sector developments and priorities. Best longitudinal narrative record of how the SI banking industry framed payments/cash issues year by year; EN versions exist from ~2014.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off bulk PDF download of the full archive (2001–2025) from wp-content/uploads, then annual delta; text-extract and index by committee/topic.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en query + navigation to founding-acts/reports page
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia members payment systems report

candidates.source_name: Bančni vestnik — e-arhiv (banking journal archive, 1952–2026, ISSN 0005-4631)
candidates.why_relevant: The association's peer-style banking journal, with a searchable archive back to 1952 filterable by year, issue, category and author, plus a 'Brezplačni članki' free tier and English special issues. Practitioner articles on payment systems, cards, instant payments and cash are the deepest SI-language analytic layer outside the central bank.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted articles; free subset + paid/login subset
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest metadata (title/author/year/issue/abstract) for the whole archive via year+issue filters; download only free-tier PDFs; treat login-gated full texts as metadata-only unless a subscription is procured. Note zbs-giz.si/bancni-vestnik/e-arhiv 301-redirects to the bv. subdomain.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije bilten plačilni promet člani
candidates.observed_blocker: Some articles require 'Prijava' (login); free subset labelled 'Brezplačni članki'

candidates.source_name: ZBS — Plačilni promet / programska orodja (payment standards & tools)
candidates.why_relevant: The association is the de facto national standards-setter for interbank payment plumbing: UPN QR specification and registered-issuer tooling, ISO 20022 XML + TKDIS conversion tool, IzvrsbeXML standard for garnishment data exchange, SEPA creditor-identifier generator, and the payment-purpose code register (šifrant kod namenov plačil). Reveals the technical rails and which vendors/issuers integrate with them.
candidates.legal_status: public downloads; standards documents may carry ZBS usage terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Version-track the downloadable spec files (UPN QR, ISO 20022 v1.0.0.23, IzvrsbeXML 1.03/1.05) — version bumps are a leading indicator of scheme change. Also capture the registered-issuer list if published.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl seed query → direct page fetch
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije bilten plačilni promet člani

candidates.source_name: ZBS — SEPA section
candidates.why_relevant: Association-maintained SEPA hub; ZBS member banks and savings banks are the adherents to EPC SCT/SDD schemes, so this page is the local mapping of which SI institutions participate in which scheme — useful for scheme-adherence coverage that EPC lists render only at pan-EU level.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual snapshot; cross-join adherent lists with EPC register.
queries_used: Slovenija fintech združenje asociacija plačilne institucije "plačilnih storitev" združenje

candidates.source_name: ZBS — Smernice / Kodeks / Standardi in priročniki (guidelines, code, standards)
candidates.why_relevant: Self-regulatory layer: sector code of conduct plus guidelines and manuals that banks apply collectively. Self-regulation often precedes or substitutes for regulation on fees, cash access and consumer disclosure, so these documents mark where the industry chose to bind itself.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PDF harvest of smernice/kodeks/standardi index pages; monitor for new/revised versions.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije bilten plačilni promet člani

candidates.source_name: ZBS — ABC bančnih izrazov (banking terminology glossary) + FAQ for bank customers
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative SL↔EN banking/payments glossary maintained by the association — the cleanest way to build the local-language query vocabulary (kartično poslovanje, plačilna kartica, bankomat, POS terminal, provizija, takojšnja plačila) used across every other source in this run.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off scrape into a term/alias table feeding query expansion; refresh yearly.
queries_used: Slovenija fintech združenje asociacija plačilne institucije "plačilnih storitev" združenje

candidates.source_name: Nacionalni svet za plačila (National Payments Council) — membership, minutes and strategy
candidates.why_relevant: Highest-value pointer for this cell: the multi-stakeholder payments forum (founded 2013) whose 22 members are exactly the SI payments actor map — ZBS, Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije, GZS, Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije, Slovensko zavarovalno združenje, Bankart, Nexi Slovenija, Dinit, Petrol Pay, Telekom Slovenije, NLB, Odbor za shemo Flik, Visa Europe, Mastercard Europe, plus AJPES, FURS, UJP, AVK, ministries and the AML office. Approved minutes of 38 sessions (2014–2026) record what associations actually argued about (fees, cash access, instant payments), and the 'Strategija razvoja plačilnega trga v Sloveniji 2024–2028' (approved 20 Dec 2023) sets the agenda. Hosted by the central bank but its content is the association layer speaking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk-download all approved session minutes (PDF, bsi.si/storage/uploads/...) plus the 2024–2028 strategy; text-mine speaker organisations to attribute positions to associations; poll for new sessions quarterly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballed from TZS member-only page mention → central bank host page
queries_used: "Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije" TZS kartice plačila trgovci gotovina stališče 2025
"Flik" shema odbor Bankart Slovenija upravljanje sheme članice

candidates.source_name: Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije (TZS) — Chamber of Commerce (retail/trade)
candidates.why_relevant: The merchant-side association (founded 17 Nov 2006), representing retailers — the acceptance side of card economics. It sits on the National Payments Council and maintains a 'Nacionalni svet za plačila' briefing page for members, plus a T-Informacije bulletin. This is where merchant-service-charge / interchange grievances and POS acceptance costs are articulated on behalf of SI retail.
candidates.legal_status: public news + member-only 'vsebine za člane' section
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl public /sl/aktualno/novice and T-Informacije index; log member-gated pages as titles-only. Consider membership or direct contact for the payments briefings.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl query on merchant card fees → site fetch
queries_used: GZS Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije kartično plačevanje provizije trgovci stališče
"Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije" TZS kartice plačila trgovci gotovina stališče 2025
candidates.observed_blocker: Payments content under /vsebine-za-clane/ returns a membership login prompt; only a one-line description of the National Payments Council is public.

candidates.source_name: Gospodarska zbornica Slovenije (GZS) — Podjetniško-trgovska zbornica (PTZ)
candidates.why_relevant: GZS is an NSP member; its PTZ branch chamber represents small business and trade — the SME merchant constituency most exposed to POS acceptance costs and cash handling. Publishes interest-representation ('Zastopanje interesov') material, collective agreements and governance/board composition that maps the retail actor set.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl PTZ 'Zastopanje interesov' and news sections with keyword filter (kartic*, provizij*, gotovin*, POS, terminal*); GZS URLs are DNN-based with TabId params — prefer the friendly /vsebina paths.
queries_used: GZS "Podjetniško-trgovska zbornica" plačilni promet POS terminali gotovina stališče

candidates.source_name: GZS — Združenja / zbornice dejavnosti (branch association directory)
candidates.why_relevant: Master index of ~30 GZS branch chambers, each a potential sector-specific source. For payments the relevant nodes are PTZ (trade), ZIT (informatics & telecoms — where payment-tech vendors and integrators sit), Zbornica poslovno storitvenih dejavnosti, Zbornica računovodskih servisov (fiscalisation/POS-software angle) and Združenje zavarovalnih posrednikov. Snowball entry point.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off scrape of the association list → seed list of sub-domains/sections for targeted crawling; re-check annually.
candidates.discovered_via_method: page fetch of GZS organisation index
queries_used: GZS "Podjetniško-trgovska zbornica" plačilni promet POS terminali gotovina stališče

candidates.source_name: GZS — Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT)
candidates.why_relevant: ICT branch association whose members include the systems integrators and software houses that build/deploy POS, fiscalisation and payment-acceptance software in Slovenia. Member lists and events reveal the vendor layer around ATM/POS estates that no bank register exposes; the ZITex export section flags SI payment-tech firms selling abroad.
candidates.legal_status: public website; member lists may be partly restricted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape member/company listings and event programmes; entity-match against payment-vendor keywords (POS, terminal, fiskalizacija, plačilni).
queries_used: GZS "Podjetniško-trgovska zbornica" plačilni promet POS terminali gotovina stališče

candidates.source_name: Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije (OZS) — Chamber of Craft and Small Business
candidates.why_relevant: Represents micro-merchants and craftspeople — the segment where cash-vs-card economics bite hardest and where mobile/softPOS adoption is being pushed. Observed positions supporting digital payments and mPOS for small traders, plus guidance on cash-handling rules (e.g. the €5,000 cash-acceptance ceiling). Regional OOZ chapters republish operational guidance, giving a second harvestable layer.
candidates.legal_status: public website; some member-only advisory content
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl OZS news/advisory sections and the 'Obrtnik podjetnik' magazine; keyword filter gotovin*, kartic*, POS, provizij*. Also crawl regional OOZ sites (e.g. ooz-logatec.si) which mirror central guidance.
queries_used: Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije provizije kartično plačevanje trgovci gotovina

candidates.source_name: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije (ZPS) — Slovene Consumers' Association
candidates.why_relevant: Independent non-profit consumer body and NSP member. Operates a free bank-fee comparison tool covering 15 banks and savings banks, refreshed roughly every two months, plus market reviews on basic payment accounts, card choice and ATM withdrawal costs (incl. DCC losses). This is the only regularly-updated cross-bank retail pricing aggregation outside the central bank's annual comparison.
candidates.legal_status: public articles + some subscriber-only content; ZPS copyright
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bi-monthly snapshot of the account/package comparison pages; parse fee tables per institution into a time series. Respect subscriber-only boundaries; cross-check against Banka Slovenije 'Primerjava stroškov nekaterih bančnih storitev' PDFs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl query on consumer bank-cost comparison
queries_used: Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije primerjava bančnih stroškov kartice bankomati analiza
Zveza potrošnikov Slovenije zps.si bančne storitve stroški primerjalnik

candidates.source_name: Odbor za shemo Flik (Flik scheme committee) / Flik scheme, operated with Bankart
candidates.why_relevant: A bank-collective scheme body: competing SI banks formed the Flik instant-payment scheme with an inter-bank committee setting common rules, technically run by Bankart on the Bips IP infrastructure. The 'Odbor za shemo Flik' sits on the National Payments Council in its own right. Publishes adoption figures (~776k active users, ~80k added in 2025) and merchant onboarding rules — collective payment data no single bank publishes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track flik.si participating-bank list and any usage statistics; harvest Bankart's public scheme/merchant-onboarding PDFs and annual reports; cross-read Flik items in NSP minutes for the numbers banks disclose collectively.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballed from NSP member list → sl scheme query
queries_used: "Flik" shema odbor Bankart Slovenija upravljanje sheme članice

candidates.source_name: Združenje Povezani smo — cash-rights advocacy association
candidates.why_relevant: Civil-society association that collected 56,000+ signatures (2023) for a constitutional right to use cash, culminating in a National Assembly constitutional amendment (reported 67–1) enshrining the right to use cash in banking and legal transactions. Materially changes the SI cash-access policy environment — a hard constraint on branch/ATM rationalisation and on any cashless-acceptance strategy. Caveat: an activist body with unrelated campaigns; treat as an actor, not as a data source, and corroborate.
candidates.legal_status: news coverage; association's own site not located in this pass
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track via media mentions and the parliamentary record (DZ RS) for the constitutional amendment and implementing legislation; locate the association's own domain in a follow-up pass before citing it directly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl query snowballed from OZS cash search
queries_used: "Združenje Povezani smo" gotovina plačevanje pravica Slovenija
Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije provizije kartično plačevanje trgovci gotovina

candidates.source_name: ZBS — Izobraževalni programi (training portal)
candidates.why_relevant: The association's training catalogue is a low-noise demand signal: which payments/cards/AML/fraud topics banks are collectively paying to be trained on, and which named practitioners lecture on them (a route to expert identification and to emerging operational pain points before they surface in position papers).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape of course listings + lecturer names; topic-frequency trend over time.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije bilten plačilni promet člani

candidates.source_name: GZS media channels — Glas gospodarstva / media.gzs.si
candidates.why_relevant: GZS's own magazine and media portal carry business-side commentary and event reports (e.g. accessibility-of-services consultations) that surface chamber positions in fuller narrative form than press releases, including on payment accessibility and digitalisation of retail.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-filtered crawl (plačil*, kartic*, gotovin*, terminal*, digitalizacija trgovine); monthly.
queries_used: GZS "Podjetniško-trgovska zbornica" plačilni promet POS terminali gotovina stališče

negative_findings.description: No periodic statistical 'bilten' (bulletin) with payment, card, ATM or POS volumes was found published by Združenje bank Slovenije. Searched the site's Publikacije and Podatki sections in Slovenian.
negative_findings.result_summary: ZBS 'Publikacije' contains only paid handbooks (interest calculation, UCP 600 / URDG 758 translations, EFCB textbook) plus the Bančni vestnik journal. 'Podatki bančnega sektorja' shows eight chart images (bank count, employees, balance-sheet total, ROA/ROE, loans/deposits) explicitly credited 'Vir: Banka Slovenije' — no payments/cards/ATM series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The association-aggregated payment-statistics layer that exists in some countries does not exist in SI; A4 payment/card/ATM/POS statistics must come from Banka Slovenije and ECB SDW, with ZBS used for positions and structure only.

negative_findings.description: Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije's payments content sits behind a member login.
negative_findings.result_summary: The TZS page 'Nacionalni svet za plačila' under /sl/vsebine-za-clane/ shows only a one-sentence description of the council; full material (positions on card fees, cash, POS) requires TZS membership or registration.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The merchant-side view on interchange/merchant service charges is the least publicly documented part of this cell; without access, merchant positions must be inferred from NSP minutes and media.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian trade association dedicated to payment institutions, e-money issuers, PSPs or fintechs was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language searches for a PSP/fintech association returned only regulator pages (Banka Slovenije: register subjektov nadzora, ZPlaSSIED licensing, oversight of non-bank PSPs), the ZBS glossary and legal-advice blogs — no membership organisation for non-bank payment providers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The non-bank PSP layer in SI appears to be represented, if at all, through the National Payments Council (Bankart, Nexi Slovenija, Dinit, Petrol Pay, Telekom Slovenije as individual members) rather than through an association — so the NSP membership list substitutes for a missing PSP directory.

negative_findings.description: No published GZS or TZS position paper specifically on card acceptance fees / interchange for merchants was found in the public web layer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both sl and en searches surfaced collective labour agreements, chamber organisation pages and general news, but no 'stališče' document on provizije/interchange. OZS surfaced only general supportive statements about digital payments and mPOS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Merchant fee grievances — a key A4 pain-point indicator — are likely voiced in NSP sessions and member-only bulletins rather than public papers; collection strategy must pivot to NSP minutes and direct contact.

negative_findings.description: ZBS's Bančni vestnik archive path redirects to a separate subdomain.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://www.zbs-giz.si/bancni-vestnik/e-arhiv returns 301 to http://bv.zbs-giz.si/bancni-vestnik//e-arhiv (note doubled slash, and http rather than https on the Location header).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collectors must follow cross-host redirects and normalise the doubled slash, or the journal archive will be recorded as unreachable. Not verified as a liveness verdict — recorded as an observed redirect only.

negative_findings.description: ZBS annual-report page labelling appears inconsistent with the linked files.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'Ustanovni akti in poročila' page presented as 'Letno poročilo ZBS 2025' but the extracted links pointed at wp-content/uploads/2022/04/ZBS-letno-porocilo-2021_*.pdf; separately an EN 2025 report exists at wp-content/uploads/2026/04/ZBS-letno-porocilo-2025_angl_final.pdf, and an EN page titled 'Annual Report for 2025' lives at the /annual-report-for-2023/ slug.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Year attribution cannot be taken from page titles or slugs; collectors must read the year from inside the PDF or from the filename, or the time series will be mis-dated.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed observed on the ZBS news section.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'Sporočila za javnost in novice' page offers year filters (2021–2026) and category tags (sporočila za javnost, odzivi medijem, novice, obvestila) but no feed link was visible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Position-statement monitoring must be poll-and-diff over the year/category index pages rather than feed-driven, raising collection cost and latency.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check EBF/ESBG/EPC national-member directories for the ZBS entry — those profiles often carry SI country factsheets with payment and branch/ATM figures in English, filling the EN-language gap for this cell.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan machine translation of sl-only association corpora (NSP minutes, ZBS press releases, ZPS reviews) rather than expecting EN equivalents; do not use EN-only querying for this cell.

brief: Slovenia's bank/PSP association layer is dominated by one node — Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS-GIZ) — which is rich as a pointer and position source (member directory covering banks, savings banks and a separate leasing tier; 2001–2025 annual reports in SL and EN; a press archive carrying explicit sector positions on cash accessibility, instant payments and the digital euro; national payment standards such as UPN QR, ISO 20022 and the payment-purpose code register; and the Bančni vestnik journal archived back to 1952) but does NOT publish aggregated payment, card, ATM or POS statistics — its data page is chart images sourced from Banka Slovenije. The genuine cross-industry aggregation point is instead the Nacionalni svet za plačila (National Payments Council), whose 22 members map the entire SI payments actor set (ZBS, TZS, GZS, ZPS, Bankart, Nexi Slovenija, Dinit, Petrol Pay, Telekom Slovenije, Odbor za shemo Flik, Visa, Mastercard, plus ministries and agencies) and whose 38 published session minutes plus the 2024–2028 payment-market strategy are the highest-value uncollected corpus in this cell. The merchant/acceptance side (TZS, GZS Podjetniško-trgovska zbornica, OZS) is present but its payments material is largely member-gated, and no dedicated Slovenian association for non-bank PSPs or fintechs appears to exist; the consumer counterweight is ZPS, whose bi-monthly cross-bank fee comparator is the only regularly refreshed non-central-bank pricing aggregation. Cash policy is a live and unusually hard constraint here: bank-sector statements on cash accessibility now sit against a constitutionally entrenched right to pay in cash driven by the advocacy association Združenje Povezani smo.
